Name: More Farmer Bases for Get Glam
Author: slowmoth
Description:
This mod adds [b]4 new player bases for Get Glam[/b] made by[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/151860403?tab=user+files]isari112[/url][/b] with some minor edits by me :)

If you don't want to use Get Glam, but you want to use [u]one[/u] of the faces, download the original mod/assets:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13282]Cat eyes for farmer[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13284]happy eyes for farmer[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13288]non-expressive player sprite[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13286][b]more mature eyes for farmer[/b]
[/url]﻿And replace the original .xnb in Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer
